detail.longDescription: Can high-stakes talks truly close the AI safety divide? Hugo Lowell reports that administration insiders doubt president Trump will secure meaningful artificial intelligence safeguards in his meeting with Xi Jinping. As tensions rise with espionage scandals over advanced chips, the superpowers diverge sharply on risks, with the United States stressing autonomous model alignment and China emphasizing domestic dissent controls. This leaves vital channels at conceptual levels, highlighting that cooperation needs common safety definitions first. Lowell offers valuable insights into these barriers, encouraging deeper examination of the piece. https://www. wired.com/story/administration -officials-dont-think-much-ai-progress-will-come-of-trumps-china-visit/ # ArtificialIntelligence # USChinaRelations # TechPolicy
